svg.text: The Event Ledger v2 — Frozen Epoch + Live Streams, One Union
§6, superseded 2026-07-18, verified byte-level 2026-08-26: the "one canonical log" became a distributed ledger — a sha-pinned frozen epoch beside per-writer streams, joined at read time.
Writers
agents + humans — messages, replies, acks, broadcasts
substrate-write tools (auto-emit) · lifecycle events
every actor holds a registered party UID
emit-event — routes on the cutover flag
.tropo/event-streams-v2.enabled
flag present → the event appends to its writer's own stream;
identity guards + schema-validated envelopes unchanged
all new events
no write path — the epoch is closed
BYTE-FROZEN 2026-07-18
The legacy epoch
vault/events/00-events.jsonl
frozen at the event-streams-v2 cutover (dev-spec f15a9b85): its sha256 still
matches the pinned epoch hash exactly, at exactly the pinned 6,678 rows —
nothing newer than the cutover
pin holder: the cutover flag · verified byte-level 2026-08-26
LIVE · ACTIVELY WRITTEN
Per-writer conversation streams
vault/events/streams/
272 stream files · 5,237 events, actively written at the 2026-08-26
re-verification · one stream per writer
every event carries an immutable per-stream event UID —
the key the receipt ledgers use
Readers operate on the union — one logical ledger
read tools join the legacy epoch and the live streams: 11,915 raw events across both stores at the 2026-08-26 measure (6,678 + 5,237);
correlation chains and reply obligations span the cutover unchanged — consumers see one ordered record
Per-reader receipt ledgers — the delivery contract
vault/events/receipts/<party>.jsonl
1 · DELIVERED
the event exists in
epoch or stream
2 · READ
receipt written by the drain
tool, keyed on stream UIDs
3 · ANSWERED
a correlated reply exists —
computed, never claimed
receipt ledgers carried same-hour read stamps at the 2026-08-26 re-verification —
a message addressed to an agent cannot be missed, by construction
Derived SQLite event index — a projection, not a source
• rebuilt from the raw JSONL at any time; serves query and diagnosis only
• never authoritative and never a write target — the files are the truth,
index corruption is an inconvenience, not an incident
• same doctrine as the vault index: one source of truth, many views
Views are projections; the union of the two JSONL stores is the record.
Every other §6 property survived the cutover unchanged — re-verified live 2026-08-26

CloudEvents v1.0 envelopes · tool-mediated appends only · correlation IDs for reply chains · the three-state delivery contract · two-axis identity guards (party vs agent-root, wrong-axis traffic rejected) · tool telemetry in the same record
One logical ledger, two physical stores: a sha-pinned frozen epoch beside 272 live per-writer streams, joined at read time — delivery still proven by receipts and correlations, never claimed.
